# packages & data

```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggrain)
# install.packages("ggdist")
library(ggdist)
library(ggpubr)

psilaut_dem <- read.xlsx("psilaut_dem_outlier.xlsx")
AQ_DACS <- read.csv("PSILAUT_MASTER_Spreadsheet_CE_MD_5DASC.csv")
AQ_DACS <- AQ_DACS %>% 
  rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID)
psilaut_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(- "Sex", -"Group", -"IQ", -"Age", - "AQ") %>% 
  left_join(AQ_DACS)
psilaut_dem$Group <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Group)
psilaut_dem$Sex <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Sex)
psilaut_dem$Dose <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Dose)
# HARIRI_df <- read.xlsx("HARIRI_df.xlsx", sheet = "262")
task_regressor <- read.xlsx("task_regressor.xlsx", sheet = "clean")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- read.xlsx("ica_ts_harpsi_dem_beh_outlier.xlsx")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 <- read.xlsx("ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_6aug.xlsx")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5_con <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 %>% 
  filter(stimuli != "shape_1" & timewindow != "0")
behavior_hariri <- read.xlsx("summary_behavior_hariri.xlsx")

ica_ts_harpsi_demica_ts_harpsi_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(sub_visit, beh_outlier) %>% 
  full_join(ica_ts_harpsi_dem)

stimuli_type <- rep(task_regressor$stimuli_type, times = 100)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5$stimuli_type <- as.factor(stimuli_type)

stimuli <- rep(task_regressor$Stimuli_Times, times = 100)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5$stimuli <- as.factor(stimuli)

ica_ts_harpsi_dem$time[is.na(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$time)] <- 0
ica_ts_harpsi_dem$subject_id <- as.character(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$subject_id)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem$Group <- as.factor(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$Group)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem$Sex <- as.factor(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$Sex)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem$block_bin2 <- as.factor(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$block_bin2 )
ica_ts_harpsi_dem$Dose <- as.factor(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$Dose)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  filter(beh_outlier != 1)

ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose != "Low") %>% 
  filter(beh_outlier != 1)
```


# hariri ica timeseries - import data
```{r}
data_list <- list()
for (id in 0:160) {
  # Extract subject ID from the file name
  file_name <- paste0("/Users/yange/YANGE/Phd/shiftability/PSILAUT/hariri/dr12_psi_hariri_25_all/dr_stage1_subject", sprintf("%005d", id), ".txt")
  # Read the text file and import it as a data frame
  data <- read.table(file_name, header = FALSE, sep = "")  # You may need to adjust parameters like sep and header based on your data
  #transpose the data
  #data <- t(data) 
  # Set column names
  colnames(data) <- paste0("ic", 0:24)
  # Set row names as a sequence of strings
  row_names <- paste0("t", 1:nrow(data))
  row.names(data) <- row_names
  # Insert time_series column as the first column
  data$time_series <- row_names
  data$subject_id <- id+1
  id2 <- id+1
  subject_key <- sprintf("subject%04d", id2)  # Corrected sprintf usage
 
  data_list[[subject_key]] <- data
}
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, data_list)
subject <- read.xlsx("~/YANGE/Phd/shiftability/PSILAUT/hariri/psilaut_input.xlsx")
row_subs <- paste0(1:nrow(subject))
subject$subject_id <- as.numeric(row_subs)
timeseries_all <- subject%>% 
  full_join(combined_data)
timeseries_all <- timeseries_all %>% 
  select(-"paths")
write.xlsx(timeseries_all, "/Users/yange/YANGE/Phd/DFC/psilaut/ica_ts_harpsi.xlsx")

timeseries_all_clean <- timeseries_all %>% 
  select(-"ic10", -"ic13", -"ic14", -"ic16", -"ic17", -"ic15", -c(23:27)) %>% 
  rename("sub_visit2" = CNS_no)
psilaut_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  select(-"rs_meanFD", -"paths")
timeseries_all_clean <- timeseries_all_clean %>% 
  full_join(psilaut_dem)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- timeseries_all_clean %>% 
        separate(col=time_series, into=c("T", "timepoint"), sep=1, remove = FALSE) %>% 
        select(-"T")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem$timepoint <- as.numeric(ica_ts_harpsi_dem$timepoint)
write.xlsx(ica_ts_harpsi_dem, "/Users/yange/YANGE/Phd/DFC/psilaut/ica_ts_harpsi_dem.xlsx")
```

# clean time-varying fd
```{r}
HARIRI_fd_long <- HARIRI_df %>% 
  filter(ts != "mean") %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:173), names_to = "sub_visit2", values_to = "df")
HARIRI_fd_long$sub_visit2 <- gsub("sub-", '', HARIRI_fd_long$sub_visit2)
HARIRI_fd_long$timepoint <- as.numeric(HARIRI_fd_long$ts)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  left_join(HARIRI_fd_long)
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  left_join(task_regressor)
```
# Average 

```{r}
# Define the time periods to highlight
face_periods <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(34, 98, 162, 226),  # Starting points of the highlighted periods
  xmax = c(64, 128, 192, 256), # Ending points of the highlighted periods
  ymin = rep(-Inf, 2),  # Extend the rectangles to the bottom of the plot
  ymax = rep(Inf, 2)    # Extend the rectangles to the top of the plot
)

shapes_periods <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(2, 66, 130, 194),  # Starting points of the highlighted periods
  xmax = c(32, 96, 160, 224), # Ending points of the highlighted periods
  ymin = rep(-Inf, 2),  # Extend the rectangles to the bottom of the plot
  ymax = rep(Inf, 2)    # Extend the rectangles to the top of the plot
)
timewindow <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(34,  44,  54,  64,  71,  81,  91),  # Starting points of the highlighted periods
  xmax = c(39,  49,  59,  66,  76,  86,  96), # Ending points of the highlighted periods
  ymin = rep(-Inf, 1),  # Extend the rectangles to the bottom of the plot
  ymax = rep(Inf, 1)    # Extend the rectangles to the top of the plot
)

average_ts <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5 %>% 
  dplyr::select(ic0, ic2, ic6, ic1, ic3, timepoint) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), median))
# write.xlsx(average_ts, "average_ts.xlsx")
average <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(timepoint, c(7:20)) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean))
average_ts <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(Group, Dose, timepoint,) %>% 
  group_by(Group, Dose, timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), median))

summary_ica2 <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, Dose, delayed_stimuli_2, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2, 7:20, l2norm, l1norm) %>%
  group_by(Group, Dose, delayed_stimuli_2, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2) %>%
  summarise(across(
    .cols = everything(),
      median,
    .names = "{.col}_median"
  ), .groups = "drop")

summary_ica2 <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select(-"Dose", - "paths") %>% 
  right_join(summary_ica2) %>% 
  separate(delayed_stimuli_2, sep = "_", c("block2", "time2"), remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(block_bin2 = if_else(block2 == "shape", "0", if_else(block2 == "face", "1", "3")))
write.xlsx(summary_ica2, "summary_ica2.xlsx")

summary_ica_d5 <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose5 %>%
  select(Group, Dose, block_bin, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2, 3:16, l2norm) %>%
  group_by(Group, Dose, block_bin, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2) %>%
  summarise(across(
    .cols = everything(),
    .fns = list(
      median = median,
      mean = mean,
      q95 = ~quantile(.x, 0.95),
      q05 = ~quantile(.x, 0.05),
      min = min,
      max = max
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
  ), .groups = "drop")
summary_ica_d5 <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  right_join(summary_ica_d5) %>% 
  select(- "paths") 

mean_ica_stimuli_group <- ica_ts_plb_harpsi_dem %>% 
  select(Group, stimuli_delayed, c(3:16)) %>% 
  group_by(Group, stimuli_delayed) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean))


?summarise
?across
```

## shape
```{r}
pd <- position_dodge(0.6)
drug_order = c("Plb", "High")
summary_ica_d5 %>% 
  filter(block_bin == 0) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Dose, level = drug_order), y = ic12_median)) +
  # Participant lines
  geom_line(aes(group = PSILAUT_no, color = Group), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.4, 
            # position = pd,
            # position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
           ) +
  # Jittered points
  geom_point(
    aes(group = PSILAUT_no, color = Group, shape = Group),
    # position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.6),
    # position = pd,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  # Violin half (like raincloud)
  stat_halfeye(
    aes(color = Group, fill = Group),
    adjust = 0.5,
    width = 0.5,
    .width = 0,
    justification = -0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(color = Group, fill = Group),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Groups",
                    labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                    values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange")) +
   # scale_color_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange"), labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Groups",
                      labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                      values = c("dodgerblue", "darkorange")) +   
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Groups",
                     labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                     values = c(1, 2)) +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
  coord_cartesian() + # coord
  labs(
    x = "Shape",
    y = "Activity of the Left Frontoparietal Network",
    fill ="Group"
  ) +
  # scale_fill_manual(labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) + # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = fils) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c('Placebo', 'Psilocybin 5mg')) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),"cm"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    axis.text= element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, b = 3)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 10, l = 3)),
    # legend.position = c(0.92,0.9),
    legend.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.margin = margin(t=5, l=5,r=5,b=5)
  )
```

```{r}
  # geom_line(data = task_regressor,aes(x = timepoint, y = (hrf_all*0.03)) , colour = "blue") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 262, by = 20)) +
  facet_grid(rows  = vars(Dose)) +
  geom_rect(data = face_periods, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), 
            fill = "orange", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_rect(data = shapes_periods, aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), 
            fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.3)
```

## visulisation
```{r}
drug_order = c('Plb', 'High')
median_ica_ggrain <- summary_ica_con_dose5 %>% 
  dplyr::select(Group, PSILAUT_no, Dose, block_bin2, c(19:32)) %>% 
  group_by(Group, PSILAUT_no,  Dose, block_bin2) %>% 
  summarise(across(
    .cols = everything(),
    median ,
    .names = "{.col}_median"
  ), .groups = "drop")
median_ica_smooth <- summary_ica_con_dose5 %>% 
  dplyr::select( Dose, block_bin2, c(19:32)) %>% 
  group_by(block_bin2, Dose) %>% 
  summarise(across(
    .cols = everything(),
    median ,
    .names = "{.col}_median"
  ), .groups = "drop")
median_ica_ggrain %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Dose, level = drug_order), y = ic7_median_median, fill = block_bin2, color = block_bin2, shape = block_bin2)) +
  geom_line(data = median_ica_smooth,aes(x = factor(Dose, level = drug_order), y = ic7_median_median, group = block_bin2), linewidth=1.5) +
  geom_rain(alpha = .6, rain.side = 'f2x2',
            violin.args = list(color = NA, alpha = .7),
            boxplot.args = list(width = .1, alpha = .5),
            point.args = list(size = 2),
            boxplot.args.pos = list(width = .6,
                position = ggpp::position_dodgenudge(width = .6, #width needed now in ggpp version 0.5.g
                  x = c(-.2, -.13, # pre versicolor, pre virginica
                        .13, .2))), # post; post
            violin.args.pos = list(width = .9,
             position = position_nudge(x = c(rep(-.4, 25*2), rep(-.4, 32*2),# pre; pre
                                             rep(.4, 25*2), rep(.4, 32*2))))) + # id.long.var = "PSILAUT_no",
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("chartreuse4", "maroon2"), labels=c('Shape', 'Face')) +
  # scale_color_manual(values=c("chartreuse4", "maroon2"), labels=c('Shape', 'Face')) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Blocks",
                      labels = c('Shape', 'Face'),
                      values = c("chartreuse4", "maroon2")) +   
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Blocks",
                     labels = c('Shape', 'Face'),
                     values = c(1, 2)) +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
#  scale_fill_manual(values=c('orange1','steelblue1'), labels=c('Shape', 'Face')) +
#  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'PRGn')  +
#  ggplot(aes(x = factor(drug, level = level_order), y = clu6)) +
# stat_boxplot(aes(color= Group), geom="errorbar",position=position_dodge(width=0.5),width=0.1) +
# geom_boxplot(aes(color = Group),position=position_dodge(width =0.5),width=0.4) + 
#  geom_line(aes( group= id, color = asd)) + 
#  geom_point(aes(fill=asd,color = asd, group= id ),pch=21) + 
#  stat_pvalue_manual(df_p_val1,label = "p.adj.signif",label.size=6,hide.ns = T) + # p values
  coord_cartesian() + # coord
  labs(
    x = "Conditions",
    y = "Median beta-values of ICN activity",
  ) +
  # scale_fill_manual(labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) + # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = fils) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c('Placebo', '5mg Psilocybin')) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),"cm"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    axis.text= element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
```

# L2 Norm and sd
```{r}
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
    mutate("l2norm" = sqrt(ic0^2 + ic1^2 + ic2^2 + ic3^2 + ic4^2 + ic5^2 + ic6^2 + ic7^2 + ic8^2 + ic9^2 + ic11^2 + ic12^2 + ic18^2 + ic19^2))
ica_ts_harpsi_dem <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
    mutate("l1norm" = abs(ic0) + abs(ic1) + abs(ic2) + abs(ic3) + abs(ic4) + abs(ic5) + abs(ic6) + abs(ic7) + abs(ic8) + abs(ic9) + abs(ic11) + abs(ic12) + abs(ic18) + abs(ic19))

write.xlsx(ica_ts_harpsi_dem, "ica_ts_harpsi_dem.xlsx")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose5 <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con %>% 
  filter(Dose != "Low")
ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose2 <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con %>% 
  filter(Dose != "High")
summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l1norm) ~ Dose * Group + block_bin * Group + scale(df) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no), data = ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose2))
# Dose.L            -1.785e-01  1.281e-02  2.512e+04 -13.936  < 2e-16 ***
# Group1            -1.899e-01  8.547e-02  6.339e+01  -2.222 0.029896 *  
# block_bin1        -1.448e-01  1.687e-02  2.513e+04  -8.586  < 2e-16 ***
# Dose.L:Group1      8.054e-02  1.741e-02  2.511e+04   4.625 3.76e-06 ***
# Group1:block_bin1  6.988e-02  2.296e-02  2.513e+04   3.044 0.002339 ** 
summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l2norm_median) ~ Group * Dose + block_bin + scale(mean) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no), data = summary_ica_con_dose2))

summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l1norm) ~ Dose * Group + block_bin2 * Group + scale(df) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no) + (1|timepoint), data = ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose2))
  
summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l2norm) ~ block_bin2 * Group + Group * Dose + block_bin * Dose + scale(df) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no), data = ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose5))
# block_bin1        -1.284e-01  1.757e-02  2.290e+04  -7.311 2.74e-13 ***
# Group1            -2.073e-01  8.840e-02  5.836e+01  -2.345 0.022469 *  
# Dose.L            -2.878e-01  1.666e-02  2.293e+04 -17.275  < 2e-16 ***
# block_bin1:Group1  7.928e-02  2.381e-02  2.290e+04   3.330 0.000869 ***
# Group1:Dose.L      1.308e-01  1.824e-02  2.286e+04   7.168 7.85e-13 ***
# block_bin1:Dose.L  5.674e-02  1.683e-02  2.290e+04   3.371 0.000751 ***
summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l1norm_median) ~ Dose * Group + block_bin2 + scale(mean) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no/time2), data = summary_ica_con_dose5))
# Dose.L         -0.451623   0.065453 539.622808  -6.900 1.46e-11 ***
# block_bin21    -0.210917   0.057968 578.271381  -3.639 0.000299 *** 
# Dose.L:Group1   0.249365   0.087779 537.544003   2.841 0.004670 **  
lmer_l1norm <- lmerTest::lmer(scale(l1norm_median) ~ Dose * Group * block_bin2 + scale(mean) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no/time2), data = summary_ica_con_dose5)
emmeans::emmeans(lmer_l1norm, list(pairwise ~ Dose | Group * block_bin2))  

summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l1norm) ~ Dose * Group + block_bin2 * Group + scale(df) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no) + (1| timepoint ), data = ica_ts_harpsi_dem_con_dose5))
summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(l1norm_median) ~ Dose * Group + block_bin  + scale(mean) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no), data = summary_ica_con_dose5))

sd_l2norm <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% sd_l2norm <- ica_tGroups_harpsi_dem %>% 
  select(Group, Dose, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2, l2norm, block_bin, delayed_stimuli_times) %>%
  group_by(Group, Dose, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2, block_bin, delayed_stimuli_times) %>% 
  summarise(sd_l2norm=sd(l2norm))
sd_l2norm <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  select(Group, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2, Sex, Age, mean) %>%

# Dose.L       -0.15911    0.04813 788.08804  -3.306 0.000989 ***
summary(lmerTest::lmer(scale(sd_l2norm) ~ block_bin * Dose + Group + scale(mean) + scale(Age)  + Sex + (1 | PSILAUT_no), data = sd_l2norm_con_dose5))
```

## L2 Norm
```{r}
median_l1nrom_visual <- summary_ica_con_dose5 %>% 
  dplyr::select(Group, Dose, block_bin2, l1norm_median) %>% 
  group_by(Group, Dose, block_bin2) %>% 
  summarise(median_median_l1norm=median(l1norm_median))
pd <- position_dodge(0.6)
drug_order = c("Plb", "High")
median_l1nrom_visual %>% 
  filter(Group == "0") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Dose, level = drug_order), y = median_l2norm)) +
    # Participant lines
  geom_line(aes(group = PSILAUT_no, color = Group), alpha = 0.5, size = 0.4, 
            # position = pd,
            # position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)
           ) +
# Violin half (like raincloud)
  stat_halfeye(
    aes(color = Group, fill = Group),
    adjust = 0.5,
    width = 0.5,
    .width = 0,
    justification = -0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(color = Group, fill = Group),
    width = 0.2,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # Jittered points
  geom_point(
    aes(group = PSILAUT_no, color = Group, shape = Group),
    # position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.6),
    # position = pd,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Groups",
                    labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                    values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange")) +
   # scale_color_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange"), labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Groups",
                      labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                      values = c("dodgerblue", "darkorange")) +   
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Groups",
                     labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                     values = c(1, 2)) +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
  coord_cartesian() + # coord
  labs(
    x = "Shape",
    y = "Median L2 Norm",
    fill ="Group"
  ) +
  # scale_fill_manual(labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) + # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = fils) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c('Placebo', 'Psilocybin 5mg')) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),"cm"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    axis.text= element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, b = 3)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 10, l = 3)),
    # legend.position = c(0.92,0.9),
    legend.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.margin = margin(t=5, l=5,r=5,b=5)
  )
```

# Reconfiguration speed
```{r}
time <- rep(paste(1:262, sep=""), times = 161)
series <- rep(paste("t", 1:262, sep=""), times = 161)
distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s$timepoint <- time
distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s$time_series <- series
distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s <- distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s %>% 
  rename("sub_visit2"= "1") 
distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s <- distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s %>% 
  rename("dist"= "0") %>% 
  select(- "...1")
distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s$timepoint <- as.numeric(distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s$timepoint)
distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s <- ica_ts_harpsi_dem %>% 
  dplyr::select("sub_visit2", "PSILAUT_no", Group, Sex, Age, Dose, timepoint, time_series, mean, df, delayed_stimuli_times,hrf_face, block_bin) %>% 
  right_join(distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s)
write.xlsx(distance_dynamic_manhattan_all_lag5s, "distance5s_manhattan_all_dem.xlsx")

summary_dist <- distance5s_manhattan_all_dem %>%
  select(Group, Dose, delayed_stimuli_times, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2, dist) %>%
  group_by(Group, Dose, delayed_stimuli_times, PSILAUT_no, sub_visit2) %>%
  summarise(across(
    .cols = everything(),
    
    .fns = list(
      median = median,
      mean = mean,
      q95 = ~quantile(.x, 0.95),
      max = max
    ),
    .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
  ), .groups = "drop")
summary_dist <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  right_join(summary_dist) %>% 
  select(- "paths") %>% 
  separate(delayed_stimuli_times, sep = "_", c("block", "time"), remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(block_bin = if_else(block == "shape", "0", if_else(block == "face", "1", "3")))
```

## DB index -dose 5
```{r}
library(clusterSim)

index_db_pam <- function(data,  dismtr) {
  db <- c()
  for (i in 1:15) {
    clu <- pam(dismtr, i, diss = TRUE, pamonce = 4, metric = "manhattan", stand = FALSE)  
    index_db <- index.DB(data, clu$clustering, dismtr, centrotypes = "medoids", p=1, q=2)
    db[i] <- index_db$DB
  }

  k <- 1:15
  db_index <- as.data.frame(cbind(k, db))
  write.xlsx(db_index, "db_index_psilaut_hariri.xlsx")
  plot(db_index$k, db_index$db,xlab =  "Cluster number k",
       ylab = "Davies - Bouldin Index",
       main = "Davies - Bouldin Plot", cex.main=1,
       col = "dodgerblue1", cex = 0.9 ,
       lty=1 , type="o" , lwd=1, pch=4,
       bty = "l",
       las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8, tcl  = -0.2)
}

dismtr <- dist(ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5[7:20], method = "manhattan")
index_db_pam(ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5[7:20], dismtr)

```


## CH index -dose 5
```{r}
dismtr <- dist(ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5[7:20], method = "manhattan")
index_ch_pam <- function(data, dismtr) {
  db <- c()
  for (i in 1:15) {
  clu <- pam(data,i, diss = FALSE, pamonce = 4, metric = "manhattan", stand = FALSE) 
  index_ch <- index.G1(data, clu$clustering, d=dismtr, centrotypes="medoids" )
  db[i] <- index_ch}

  ch <- db[1:15]
  k <- 1:15
  ch_index <- as.data.frame(cbind(k, ch))
  write.xlsx(ch_index, "ch_index_psilaut_hariri.xlsx")
  plot(ch_index$k, ch_index$ch,xlab =  "Cluster number k",
       ylab = "Calinski-Harabasz Pseudo F-statistic",
       main = "Calinski-Harabasz Pseudo F-statistic Plot", cex.main=1,
       col = "dodgerblue1", cex = 0.9 ,
       lty=1 , type="o" , lwd=1, pch=4,
       bty = "l",
       las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8, tcl  = -0.2)
}

index_ch_pam(ica_ts_harpsi_dem_dose5[7:20], dismtr)
ch_index <- read.xlsx("ch_index_psilaut_hariri.xlsx")

plot(ch_index$k, ch_index$ch,xlab =  "Cluster number k",
       ylab = "Calinski-Harabasz Pseudo F-statistic",
       main = "Calinski-Harabasz Pseudo F-statistic Plot", cex.main=1,
       col = "dodgerblue1", cex = 0.9 ,
       lty=1 , type="o" , lwd=1, pch=4,
       bty = "l",
       las = 1, cex.axis = 0.8, tcl  = -0.2)
dev.off()
```
